label: copy-phase input k fed back early in the copy (recall 1-2, long sequences)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, at steps where the input is the letter k (99.7% of activation mass). That k is the model own echoed output of original token 0 or 1. It never fires in the original or delimiter phases, and it does not fire on k in the original phase. Activity is concentrated early in the copy: recall_idx 2 (66% of mass) and 1 (28%), with a little at 3 and nothing after 4. It is strongly biased toward long sequences (L=9 gives 66% of mass, L=8 gives 24%, L<=4 gives nothing). The strongest activations come from sequences like l k t ... where k is original token 1 and the next output is t, s or x, but no single next-token condition picks them out cleanly. The precision ceiling is low: only about 20-28% of early-copy k inputs in long sequences activate, and adding next-output or in_count conditions did not clearly separate active from inactive cases. Rare activations on inputs t, u and p.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues.
